rulings: 2026-08-14: machines are game versions over the shared HelmCortex/DotCortex overworld; scopes are catch locations, never regions (supersedes the 2026-08-02 scope-to-region draft)

2026-08-31: role field added (hub/client/companion) — the single machine-readable source of each machine's fleet role for the Fleet Nervous System session lane and the P2 router; kikin-kushi=hub (the t1700 fileserver), ThinkPads=client, S24=companion. A machine matches its own hostname against a row to learn its role; unknown host defaults to client (the safe role — never crawls the brain tree, never writes the shared index).
overworld: HelmCortex + DotCortex — the one shared Kanto/Johto-equivalent every cartridge plays on

machines.note: Stadium has no wild encounter tables; spawn semantics for S24-caught sessions are a Stage 4 question (rental / link-borrow from the cartridges)

future: next machines take firered/leafgreen, then Gen 2 (gold/silver/crystal, heartgold/soulsilver); new fleet members get a row here when their version is ruled
